senses.gloss: 1. तेन m. a note or cadence introductory to a song.
2. ते॑न ind. (instr. of 2. त॑) in that direction, there (correl. to येन, ‘in which direction, where’), SaddhP. iv; Pāṇ. ii, 1, 14, Kāś.
in that manner, thus (correl. to येन, ‘in what manner’), PārGṛ. ii, 2; Mn. iv, 178; Vop. v, 7
on that account, for that reason, therefore (correl. to येन [Mn.; MBh.], य॑द् [ŚBr. iv, 1, 5, 7; Mn. i, iii; R. ii], यस्मात् [MBh.; R.], यतस् [Sāh. i, 2; Hit.])
तेन हि, therefore, now then, Śak.; Vikr. i, 3/4.
